items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: That's the first time I ever saw Earl Hines, up there. ... Last night we met Earl, he was her lawyer for the last three years.

ctx.x: Nothing much happening musically any more there.
No. That's the first time I ever saw Earl Hines, up there. I met Barney Kessel up there when he came to town.
